title: Variant-effect prediction: a model of a sequence change
learnerTask: Follow one genomic change through transcript-dependent annotation, prediction and relevant measurement.

sourceSupport.title: Ensembl: Variant consequences
sourceSupport.sectionsRead: Introduction: consequences for each allele and overlapping transcript; intron and coding-sequence consequence categories
sourceSupport.scope: One genomic position can have different transcript-dependent annotations.
sourceSupport.limits: Actual request redirected to jun2026 archive; no new release-specific completeness claim, real coordinate or transcript ID.

sourceSupport.title: Standards and Guidelines for the Interpretation and Reporting of Sequence Variants in Cancer: A Joint Consensus Recommendation of the Association for Molecular Pathology, American Society of Clinical Oncology, and College of American Pathologists.
sourceSupport.scope: Separate annotations and computational prediction from assessed somatic clinical significance.
sourceSupport.limits: Historical primary abstract only; no fresh full-guideline or variant classification review.

sourceSupport.title: Calibration of computational tools for missense variant pathogenicity classification and ClinGen recommendations for PP3/BP4 criteria.
sourceSupport.scope: Model evidence requires its task and calibration; a score is not automatically probability or benefit.
sourceSupport.limits: Complete abstract only; germline missense calibration scope does not establish splice performance, cancer response or a specific 0.92 scale.

fictionAndLimits: Specify transcript context, prediction definition and relevant observation separately. A genomic coordinate, annotation label or model score is not an established functional effect or product benefit.
publicOriginals: Editable native light/dark SVG, original construction brief and this minimal custody record. Private scripts, source bodies and render captures are excluded.
